name: Fake Christians
overview: Scripture warns against those who profess faith with their words but lack genuine obedience and heart commitment to God, as seen in Isaiah 29:13 where people honor God only with their lips while their hearts are distant. Jesus emphasizes that merely calling Him 'Lord' is insufficient without doing the Father's will (Matthew 7:21, Luke 6:46). Believers are called to discern and avoid those who cause divisions and contradict sound doctrine (Romans 16:17), while maintaining humility by refraining from judgment (Matthew 7:1). Moreover, Christians may face false accusations for their faith, highlighting the reality of opposition for genuine followers (Matthew 5:11).
